analogy.rationale: Adenosine receptors are Gi-coupled GPCRs that are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so antagonists produce little transcriptional change; the closest reference classes are other purinergic/GPCR antagonists and phosphodiesterase inhibitors that act on the same cAMP axis, while adenosine receptor agonists share the receptor but opposite direction.
